title: claude-session exec|resume|start --dry-run --json
description: Printed for exit 0, 12 (would_fail set, would_refuse null) and 20 (would_refuse set; checked first). A dry run allocates nothing, runs no hooks and never finalizes a run. schema_newer and failed still print the error envelope.

csession_id.description: The session the plan applies to: null when a real launch would allocate a new session (a new session or a fork); the existing id for resume, start --resume without --fork, or an inspected start record (exec --session-id).

run.description: The run number a real launch would create or adopt (1 for a new session or fork).

labels.description: Labels the session would have after the launch.

taints.description: Whether the launch would taint the session (third-party-reading run).

repo.description: Repo id host/<full project path> (no . or .. segments).

has_prompt.description: Whether a prompt would be delivered (given now or carried from a not-started previous run).

input_files.description: Basenames the run would get in $CSESSION_DIR/inputs/<run>/.

permission_profile.description: Profile name from config, or file:<sha256 prefix> for a profile file (snapshotted at launch).

timeout.description: Effective wall-clock bound in seconds for the run's mode; null for none.

sandbox_lowered.description: true when the run is third-party-reading and its resolved sandbox mode is below required (whatever the origin); a real launch audits it at adoption and warns.

config_hash_changed.description: exec --session-id --dry-run: whether the current config hash differs from the one start froze; null otherwise.

additionalProperties.description: flag-implied: set by --reads-third-party (sandbox, setting_sources, mcp, env.inherit). derived: the repo id derived from the origin remote of the caller's cwd (or --cwd); never for kinds whose cwd is session-dir.

origins.description: For every resolved setting, where its value came from.

settings.description: The generated Claude Code settings (hooks, permissions, sandbox).

claude_argv.description: argv for claude; session paths shown as they would be created.

env_names.description: Names of variables the session would receive. Values are never printed.

source.description: config: a configured entry; flag: a per-invocation --hook entry.

selected.description: Whether the entry's selectors match this run.

hooks.description: Configured and per-invocation hook entries; hooks are not run by a dry run.

would_refuse.description: Refusal a real launch would hit (exit 20), else null.

would_fail.description: Launch-validation end_reason a real launch would hit, else null. Reported also when would_refuse is set (the refusal decides the exit: 20). Never a hook end_reason (hooks are not run).

warnings.description: Non-fatal warnings (e.g. unknown kind fell back to the review profile; third-party-reading run not sandboxed).
